verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas ships a documented Editor API (api.playcanvas.com/editor) explicitly for programmatic scene manipulation, asset management, and custom tool integration, plus PCUI for building browser-based editor tools and a REST API for external automation. This is further extended by an official, npm-published Editor MCP server enabling AI-driven automation of the Editor. Missing for 10: independent hands-on developer accounts specifically validating custom editor plugin workflows (community evidence focuses on other aspects like offline dev, not this API in practice).
